title: Shiva

facts.act: Bianca 在下葬次日自己开门进 Renata 的公寓，带一只盖着锡纸的炖菜；头上别黑蕾丝小圆片，穿朴素但低胸的黑裙；Renata 打趣她这身"shiva chic"。
facts.anchor: Bianca let herself into my apartment the day after the funeral with a casserole covered in foil

facts.act: Bianca 让 Renata 只换件干净衬衫、别动手，并指 Mark 的房间要 Renata 把镜子盖住；Renata 把 Mark 床上的床单扯下来挂到他的落地镜上（一瞬间以为镜里是 Mark 回看她）。
facts.anchor: yanked his sheet off the bed

facts.act: Bianca 说自己已叫所有人带现金来，好让 Renata 付 Mark 那一半房租；Renata 回六月房租已付、楼是稳定租金楼、还有存款，并拒绝让 Star 搬进 Mark 的空房间（"我还需要自己的空间"）。
facts.anchor: half of the rent. You thought about that?

facts.act: 来客把现金投进一只空的 Bustelo 咖啡罐，带啤酒、威士忌、Moishe's 的 challah、Veniero's 红白绳饼干盒，Tanya 带一大束紫白百合；Renata 在 Mark 的梳妆台上、电视机旁摆祭坛（Kurt 多年前给他拍的褪色宝丽来），放 Mark 最爱的唱片（先 Hunky Dory 和 Transformer），从书架抽 Hart Crane、Emily Dickinson、Rimbaud《Illuminations》随机翻开朗读；Renata 要的那首"让姑娘当女王"的诗，正是书脊开裂处。
facts.anchor: they passed around an empty Bustelo can for cash

facts.act: Julie 拿起 Renata 在 Mark 医院垂危那夜读的《New York》杂志，念出下东城封面报道里买断/赶走租金管制房客的话术（先给钱再涨租），一句"That's fucking chilling"；Bianca 反讽"还给他们救生衣，真慷慨"。
facts.anchor: Julie picked up the New York magazine I had been reading the night Mark was dying in the hospital

facts.act: Star 讲有伙人专把"你家公寓闹鬼"的念头塞进人脑子再上门收费；Annie 说认识的一个女孩在室友死后门口收到过"Manhattan Remedy"传单；Julie 定调他们不是驱鬼而是骗子，是替房东赶人。
facts.anchor: convincing people their apartments are haunted

facts.act: Claude 到场，手搭上 Renata 的肩，说节哀、问她吃没吃，要不要给她弄一盘；见 Renata 脸色不对就提议出去透气，两人离开派对，走到 First Avenue 等红绿灯。
facts.anchor: I knew it was Claude from her touch

facts.act: Claude 讲她在 St. Vincent 的病人：一个同龄、失智又失明的病人反复指着角落的椅子问"那把椅子里的女人是谁"，并描述出此前死在那个房间的老妇人；她只让 Renata 过几天再打电话，随后用她的腰带环一把把人拉近；Renata 回家时众人已半醉。
facts.anchor: She pulled me close by my belt loop

relations.anchor: Bianca and I grew up together

relations.relation: Renata 的母亲，已去世（Renata 坚持体面下葬，用了松木棺材）

relations.subject: Mark

relations.anchor: We lived together well, mostly because neither of us were pack rats

relations.anchor: been seeing each other a few months—long enough for some dykes to practically get hitched

relations.anchor: Claude was a nurse at St. Vincent

relations.relation: Renata 探病 David Green（后来去世）时第一次见到她——当时她已在 St. Vincent 当护士
relations.anchor: I had first met her when I was visiting David Green

relations.subject: Bianca
relations.relation: 名字取自第一任 Mrs. Jagger；小时候人人都说她像 Mick Jagger；Mick 娶了拉丁裔替身之后，Bianca 意识到自己能"pass"
relations.anchor: Bianca took her name from the first Mrs. Jagger

relations.subject: Star
relations.relation: Bianca 的朋友，后来也成为 Renata 的朋友；两人是 pier kids 时期结识，Bianca 自认对她有点责任

relations.subject: Julie
relations.relation: Renata 的高中时代朋友（当年会翘课陪她混）；刚满三十岁，生日在四月
relations.anchor: cut class to bum around with me

relations.subject: Julie
relations.relation: 做公益的住房律师（本章的租金管制/收买房客知识都由她讲）
relations.anchor: Julie was a do-gooder housing lawyer

relations.subject: Kurt
relations.relation: Mark 的前男友（Kurt 多年前给 Mark 拍的那些褪色宝丽来）；如今面临被赶走
relations.anchor: Kurt had taken of him years ago, when they were dating

relations.subject: David / Darryl
relations.relation: 两人又睡到了一起（Darryl 边说话边解开 David 衬衫的一颗扣子）
relations.anchor: They must be sleeping with each other again

relations.subject: Annie
relations.relation: Renata 的前女友（Renata 发现她毒瘾严重后明确分手）；也是 shiva 上"今年一整年都干净"的那位
relations.anchor: I broke up with her in no uncertain terms

relations.subject: Tanya
relations.relation: 1979 年与 Renata 几乎夜夜同床的旧情人（元旦到劳工节），从不肯称 Renata 为女友
relations.anchor: we slept together pretty much every night in 1979

relations.subject: François
relations.relation: 已故的朋友：Renata 和 Leon 潜入他公寓取遗物；上月去世后，他的鬼魂出现在 Renata 的消防梯上
relations.anchor: François, who had died the month before, was on my fire escape

relations.subject: Audrey
relations.relation: Tanya 的室友；以偷别人的点子做自己的作品、却照样进每个市中心群展而闻名
relations.anchor: Tanya lived with her because she was a cheap supply of drama and cocaine

relations.subject: Brooke
relations.relation: 旧相好之一，Renata 从没当真，最后回了丈夫身边

turning_point: 本章转折点：Mark 的 shiva 从"追忆他"滑成"各谈各的近况/谈公寓闹鬼的公司"，Renata 只能旁观；直到 Claude 到场，用一个"死者在椅子里"的护士见闻回应她见鬼的经历，却不肯明说信不信、只留一句"过几天打给我"——Renata 的见鬼秘密与这段关系都被悬在半空，而驻足在马克的死亡与她的关系之间。
